scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL lightness depth-encoding, clear typographic hierarchy, and breadcrumb navigation show real design intent, though many leaf cells are too small to read at overview scale.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is honest (treemap sums file sizes proportionally via `.sum(d => d.size || 0)`), color is categorical-only with no quantitative deception, domain is data-driven, and zoom uses scale domain-swap correctly; minor fragility in the key function (name+depth+parentName can collide for identically-named files across subdirs) and random lightness noise on leaf cells (`rng()*10`) is aesthetic clutter rather than a true encoding violation.
scores.stress_test_note: Click-only zoom with named .interrupt() calls, unified pointer events, and correctly-scoped mutable scales make all five interaction traps non-issues.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8 colorblind-safe hues (at the warning threshold but reinforced by spatial grouping), smart label suppression on small cells, breadcrumb navigation, and a smooth 750ms zoom transition that keeps all elements moving as one unit — complexity is well-managed and the viewer is never asked to track more than one conceptual structure at a time.

proposer: Simplified `updateVisibility`: inlined the `isVisible` helper (used once), replaced the if/else duration branch with a ternary selecting between transition and immediate selection, and removed blank lines. Saves 9 lines, no behavior change.
